tagline: The global travel marketplace connecting travelers, partners, and advertisers to shape the future of travel through trusted brands, technology, and first-party data.
hero_kpi_rationale: Lodging revenue represents 80% of total revenue, making it the company's primary growth driver, fueled by room night growth and Vrbo's expansion in vacation rentals.
company_description: Expedia Group, Inc. operates as an online travel company in the United States and internationally. The company operates through B2C, B2B, and trivago segments. The B2C segment includes Brand Expedia, a full-service online travel brand offering various travel products and services; Hotels.com for lodging accommodations; Vrbo, an online marketplace for alternative accommodations; and Orbitz, Travelocity, ebookers, and Wotif Group. The B2B segment provides services to various travel and non-travel companies, including airlines, offline travel agents, online retailers, corporate travel management, and financial institutions, which leverage its travel technology and access its diverse supply to enhance their offerings and market Expedia Group rates and availability to travelers. The trivago segment sends referrals to online travel companies and travel service providers from hotel metasearch websites. kpis.name: Lodging Revenue Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue derived from accommodation bookings (hotels and rentals).
kpis.description: Lodging accounts for the vast majority of revenue, with sustained growth in booked room nights (+8% in 2025).
kpis.signal: Lodging = core pillar of the business model

kpis.name: Room Nights Growth
kpis.explanation: Change in the total number of booked accommodation room nights via the platform.
kpis.description: Room nights increased by 8% in 2025, compared to +9% in 2024, reflecting improving demand in the second half of the year.
kpis.signal: Solid growth despite slowdown compared to 2024

kpis.name: Average Daily Rate Change
kpis.explanation: Change in the average price per booked accommodation night.
kpis.description: Average daily rate increased by 1% in 2025, after a 1% decline in 2024, supported by recovering demand.

kpis.name: Total Advertising Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from advertising on Expedia's websites and apps, and via trivago.
kpis.description: Total advertising revenue reached $1.175 billion in 2025 ($758 million direct + $417 million via trivago), up 19%.

kpis.name: Air Ticket Bookings Growth
kpis.explanation: Change in the number of air tickets booked via the platform.
kpis.description: Air bookings increased by 3% in 2025, compared to +6% in 2024, with improvement toward year-end.

kpis.name: Total Lodging Properties
kpis.explanation: Total number of accommodations (hotels and alternatives) available on the platform.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, Expedia offered 3.6 million properties, including 2.4 million via Vrbo.
kpis.signal: One of the largest accommodation supply platforms

risks.title: Tax Compliance and Interpretation of Laws
risks.summary: Expedia is exposed to changes in tax law interpretations by authorities and modifications to U.S. and international tax legislation. The company could face higher tax rates or additional tax liabilities.
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at the beginning of section Item 1A (first factor listed), strong language 'adversely affect our business, financial performance', stable trend but with increased exposure to international legislative changes explicitly mentioned, high-weight regulatory category

risks.title: Credit Rating Downgrade
risks.summary: A downgrade of Expedia's credit rating (currently Baa2/BBB) would lead to higher borrowing costs and limited access to capital markets. Interest rates on existing debt would increase, significantly impacting financial condition.
risks.score_rationale: Risk located in the middle of the report (liquidity section), explicit language 'could have a material impact on our financial condition', stable trend with active monitoring (three agencies mentioned), high-weight credit category for a company with $5.3 billion in debt

risks.title: Convertible Debt Refinancing
risks.summary: Expedia must refinance $1 billion in convertible notes maturing in February 2026. The estimated conversion value exceeds the principal, creating significant potential dilution for existing shareholders.
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in contractual obligations (end of report), direct language regarding $1 billion in convertible notes maturing February 2026 with conversion value above principal, increasing trend (imminent maturity), critical capital category

risks.title: Unquantifiable Tax Liabilities
risks.summary: Expedia has recorded $298 million in unrecognized tax benefits for which it cannot reliably estimate the amount or timing of payment. These contingent liabilities could materialize unpredictably.
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in contractual obligations (end of report), cautious language 'cannot make a reasonably reliable estimate', significant amount of $298 million in unrecognized tax benefits, stable but persistent trend, regulatory category

risks.title: Seasonal Cash Flow Volatility
risks.summary: Expedia's hotel bookings follow a pronounced seasonal cycle: the first half of the year generates positive cash flows (bookings before usage), the second half generates negative cash flows. This volatility complicates cash management.
risks.score_rationale: Risk described in detail in the liquidity section (middle of report), descriptive language on seasonal fluctuations affecting annual cash flows, stable and structural trend tied to business model, macro/operational category

risks.title: Availability and Cost of Future Refinancing
risks.summary: Expedia cannot guarantee that the cost and availability of future borrowings, including refinancings, will be acceptable. Access to capital markets could tighten in the event of economic deterioration or unfavorable market conditions.
risks.score_rationale: Risk stated at the end of the liquidity section, cautionary language 'There can be no assurance', explicit recognition of uncertainty regarding future conditions, stable trend but with increased exposure (total debt $5.3 billion + $1 billion convertible), capital category

ai_positioning.summary: Expedia acknowledges that technological developments in generative AI are increasingly being used to create competing offerings, including AI-powered digital planning and assistance tools, intensifying competition. The company does not detail its own internal AI initiatives.
evidence: Technological developments in generative AI tools are increasingly being used to create competing offerings, such as AI powered digital planning and assistance, further increasing competition.
